newsitem.title: USA: GE, unions reach tentative 3-year pact.
newsitem.headline: GE, unions reach tentative 3-year pact.

text.p: General Electric Co and a group of 14 unions said late Sunday they have reached a tentative contract agreement that covers 46,000 unionized workers.

The parties said they would not disclose the terms of the agreement until the details have been reviewed with the negotiating committees and the conference boards of the International Union of Electronic Workers and the United Electrical Workers and other participating unions.
In a joint statement, the company and union leaders said the agreement was for a three-year contract.
The current pact was set to expire at midnight Sunday.
The agreements are subject to approval by the union's coordinated bargaining committee and their respective negotiating committees, conference boards and then union members.
It may take a couple of weeks for the ratification process to take place, a union spokeswoman said.
